title: Zverev Advances to US Open Quarter-finals
summary: Alexander Zverev has reached the quarter-finals of the U.S. Open after defeating Italian Luciano Darderi in a straight-sets match. The top-seeded German won with a score of 6-2, 6-2, 7-6(3) on Monday. This victory marks a significant step in Zverev's campaign, especially after enduring two previous five-set matches in the tournament.
summary_points: Alexander Zverev defeated Luciano Darderi in the U.S. Open.
The match concluded in straight sets with scores of 6-2, 6-2, 7-6(3).
Zverev, the top seed, advanced to the quarter-finals.
The victory came after Zverev had previously played two five-set matches.
